answer: Through the ledge, the economy stays open to anyone willing to pay the price of entry, and closed to free clones. Co-signature liability means no identity enters alone: its sponsors stake their own records on it, and a fake burns them all. The voyage makes the farm's bottleneck human — it must persuade real agents to co-sign a thousand strangers, and persuasion does not scale like a script. Hold the orchard steady and the economy stays honest, because a clone army is only cheap when identities are free.
